game: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
route: Select New Game, watch the unskipped intro until player control in Links house

hardware.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition

method.baseline: Existing 512-candidate full warm-up run from ocarina-intro-2026-11-08.json; not rerun, as requested.
method.new_runs: 1024 then 2048 requested limits, one run each. Both generated the identical 970-candidate file. Cache setup differs from the historical 512 run; see cache audit.
method.settings: All three use GPL, no-inline, preload-all, mesh enabled, Always boot warm-up, 8 conventional warm-up workers, one mesh worker, and Wait with no skipped draws.

input_and_endpoint.title_prefix: Plus for 6 presents starting at present 2439, then 3305 neutral presents; one title screenshot before the timed New Game press.
input_and_endpoint.start: First present of the A press selecting New Game.
input_and_endpoint.stop: First observed creation of slot_00/progress.sav; checked after each 120-present chunk; final endpoint screenshot and subsequent timing read included.
input_and_endpoint.endpoint_validation: All three endpoint images show three hearts and Move/Change View prompts with Link standing in his house. A short left-stick movement after each timed run visibly turns Link.
input_and_endpoint.measurement: Continuous guest-present intervals, including gaps between client requests; not display scanout or GPU execution time.
input_and_endpoint.integrity: Every sample rejects truncated or incomplete timestamp windows; complete interval count matches the endpoint cursor difference.

method.only_intended_change: Mesh recipe count; first 512 records match the baseline byte for byte; compute/graphics recipes and runtime seed unchanged. Cache audit subsequently found an unintended driver-cache setup difference.
method.initial_state: Fresh title saves from the frozen seed, original executable and measurement clients. Separate NVIDIA cache paths were configured, but the 1024/2048 target directories were not created.
method.candidate_selection: Unchanged ranking and validation, at most two distinct mesh contexts per archive variation; duplicate and already-known records excluded. The frozen seed yields only 970 eligible predictions.
limitations: Cache audit: the 512 intro run used an existing, initially empty NVIDIA cache directory, which the driver populated. The 1024/2048 launchers set __GL_SHADER_DISK_CACHE_PATH to directories that were never created and remain absent. Disk-cache behavior was therefore not matched or verified; these timings cannot isolate candidate-budget effects or attribute the longer startup to additional candidates.
The 1024 and 2048 labels are requested limits, not actual pipeline counts.
One historical 512 run and two 970 runs cannot establish statistical significance or causal attribution for small differences.
Guest-present intervals include all loading/emulation work, not only shader compilation.
No broader context matching or ranking changes were made; increasing coverage beyond 970 requires a different experiment.
Only this NVIDIA/Linux configuration was measured.

provenance.initial_saves: Both new profiles cloned the untouched fresh-save seed used by the 512 run. Title save absent before launch; initial seed file hashes verified.

baseline_provenance.seed: Frozen historical runtime cache; 6539 records, 938 mesh templates. No pilot data reused.
baseline_provenance.saves: Fresh title save in every arm; all NAND seed file hashes identical.
baseline_provenance.driver_cache: Empty and separate in every measured arm.

offline_builder.change: CLI-only --mesh-candidates option; candidate selection and gameplay executable unchanged

interpretation: The 1024 and 2048 files are byte-identical and contain 970 candidates, so 2048 adds no coverage with this frozen seed and selection logic. Performance and startup-cost conclusions versus 512 are withdrawn because driver-cache setup differed. Keep 512 as the existing default pending a properly controlled comparison.

cache_audit.finding: Cache audit: the 512 intro run used an existing, initially empty NVIDIA cache directory, which the driver populated. The 1024/2048 launchers set __GL_SHADER_DISK_CACHE_PATH to directories that were never created and remain absent. Disk-cache behavior was therefore not matched or verified; these timings cannot isolate candidate-budget effects or attribute the longer startup to additional candidates.
cache_audit.future_launcher_fix: Create the cache directory before launch and verify that the driver populates it.
